summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired with a spec clarification about draft coverage review consuming the shared QA rules partial.

items.title: Shared draft QA rules also affect coverage review
items.rationale: The shared partial is consumed outside the draft authoring next-action path, so the spec must prevent an implementation from turning priority omissions into coverage-review user-decision blockers.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] identifies the shared partial coverage-review consumer; spec.json design_principles and acceptance_criteria do not yet constrain coverage review behavior.
